compatibleMigrations.20261105090000_property_owner_contact: Adds a nullable CRM contact reference and tenant-scoped indexes without changing existing properties, accounts, or access grants. The previous application remains compatible.
compatibleMigrations.20261106090000_agency_public_profile_col: Adds nullable public profile color columns without rewriting existing profiles. Older clients ignore the added columns and continue using the tenant palette. Retain the columns during application rollback.
compatibleMigrations.20261108090000_public_profile_addresses: Adds an initially empty public profile address registry with indexes and foreign keys, preserving existing accounts, profiles, and public identifiers. Older clients ignore the table. Retain it during application rollback to preserve chosen addresses.
compatibleMigrations.20261109090000_property_address_geocodin: Adds a nullable retry timestamp to property addresses without changing existing addresses or coordinates. Older applications ignore the column. Retain it during application rollback.
compatibleMigrations.20261110090000_lead_property_reference: Adds a nullable tenant-scoped property reference to leads and fills it from existing linked opportunities. Existing lead text, stages and opportunities are preserved; older applications ignore the new column. Retain it during application rollback.
compatibleMigrations.20261111090000_face_check_module: Adds initially empty tenant-scoped Face Check sessions, settings, rate-limit tables and constraints without rewriting existing records. Older applications ignore these tables; retain encrypted data during application rollback.
compatibleMigrations.20261112090000_face_check_candidate_acce: Adds a nullable explicit candidate user reference and index without inspecting encrypted session contacts or backfilling existing records. Candidate accounts may intentionally belong to another tenant; only minimal self-service metadata is exposed by the new application. Older applications ignore the nullable column; retain it during application rollback.
compatibleMigrations.20261113090000_face_check_invitation_ema: Adds an initially empty tenant-scoped invitation email outbox and a supporting session key. Existing encrypted sessions are not inspected or backfilled. Older applications ignore the table; retain delivery metadata during rollback to preserve deduplication and retry state.
compatibleMigrations.20261114090000_registration_unique_conta: Adds nullable normalized phone, CRECI and CPF columns to users and a nullable CNPJ to tenants, with unique indexes that ignore nulls. Existing rows are backfilled without deleting data: only the oldest account per tenant and value is keyed, so existing duplicates stay unconstrained. The previous application never writes the new columns, so its inserts and updates keep working; older clients ignore them. Retain the columns and indexes during application rollback.
compatibleMigrations.20261115090000_user_personal_cnpj: Adds one nullable CNPJ column to users and a unique index per tenant that ignores nulls. Existing rows stay null and nothing is backfilled or deleted. The previous application never reads or writes the column, so its inserts and updates keep working; older clients ignore it. Retain the column and index during application rollback.
